$comment: The motion spec: what each component does on enter, hover, press, a value change, open and close, an error and while loading, the same in every pack. 'style' follows the component style saved in the Component factory (bx-motion-hover-lift|glow|shine, bx-motion-click-press|ripple|bounce, bx-motion-scroll-fadeup|scale|slide|blur); the other names are in effects. Durations and easing are the --bx-dur-* and --bx-ease-* tokens. Under reduced motion every component shows its end state. packs says where the motion is built.

effects.style: Follows the component style (hover, click or scroll effect chosen in the Component factory)
effects.border: The border takes the brand colour on hover
effects.tint: A row or item takes a light tint on hover
effects.shake: The field shakes once when its error appears
effects.shimmer: A light sweeps across while it loads
effects.roll: A changed number rolls up into place
effects.pop: A chosen mark, chip or code slot pops
effects.spring: Opens and closes on a spring; the switch knob springs across
effects.slide: The chosen tab, step or segment slides into place
effects.settle: New rows and files settle in from above
effects.grow: Bars and meters grow to their value
effects.drop: A list or menu drops down from its field
effects.effect: The component is the effect itself (text, motion, backdrop and micro interaction categories)
